sanskrit_verse: पणान् एकशपhe दद्याच् चतुरः पञ्च मानुषे । महिषोष्ट्रगवां द्वौ द्वौ पादं पादमजाविके ॥
transliteration: paṇān ekaśaphe dadyāc caturaḥ pañca mānuṣe | mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ dvau dvau pādaṃ pādam ajāvike ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In transactions involving livestock, the measure of exchange is fixed by divine ordinance: one sheep equals one paṇa; four sheep equal five humans in value; two buffaloes, two horses, two cows match one goat in equivalence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Value equivalences derive exclusively from SPH's cosmic ordering.
Causation: Transactional integrity arises through precise numerical alignment with dharmic weights.
Capacity-based responsibility: Parties must align their giving and receiving within pre-established vibrational ratios.
Restoration logic: Misalignment in trade disrupts universal balance and requires immediate rectification via correct equivalency.
Consciousness alignment: Accurate exchange reflects inner harmony with the Supreme Will.
executable_legal_axioms: IF transaction involves sheep THEN assign 1 paṇa per head.
IF transaction evaluates human labor against animals THEN use ratio of 4 sheep = 5 humans.
IF exchange includes buffalo, horse, cow THEN apply equivalence of 2 units each to 1 goat unit.
IF discrepancy detected in trade value THEN auto-trigger corrective realignment protocol based on above equivalencies.
IF party fails to recognize assigned value THEN initiate consciousness-resonance recalibration sequence.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes a foundational metric for adjudicating disputes concerning commercial valuation of animate assets. The court must ensure all economic assessments reflect these divinely ordained equivalences without deviation. Responsibility thresholds are calibrated according to capacity to perceive and execute lawful exchange, not punitive fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in the revealed truth of numeric correlation established by SPH. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential misalignment when incorrect values are exchanged, leading to karmic dissonance. Proportional responsibility rests on awareness of correct value at time of exchange. Non-punitive reality rule asserts that correction restores natural flow rather than inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vibrational Alignment Process to restore accurate perception of equivalency among transacting parties.
Deploy Karmic Reconciliation Sequence to neutralize distortions caused by erroneous exchanges.
Engage Consciousness Calibration Module to elevate trader’s ability to discern true value.
Execute Dharma Reset Protocol ensuring future trades conform automatically to revealed metrics.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Law. This regulation flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is hereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
